ترتعفن (form VIII)
# تَرْتَعِفْنَ (tartaʕifna) /tar.ta.ʕif.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# تُرْتَعَفْنَ (turtaʕafna) /tur.ta.ʕaf.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
